segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַכּוֹתֵב אֶת נְכָסָיו לַאֲחֵרִים וְהִנִּיחַ אֶת בָּנָיו – מַה שֶּׁעָשָׂה עָשׂוּי, אֶלָּא אֵין רוּחַ חֲכָמִים נוֹחָה הֵימֶנּוּ. רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אוֹמֵר: אִם לֹא הָיוּ בָּנָיו נוֹהֲגִים כַּשּׁוּרָה – זָכוּר לַטּוֹב.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «one who wrote» a document granting «his property to others» as a gift «and left his sons» with nothing, «what he did is done,» i.e., it takes effect; «but the Sages are displeased with him. Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says: If» he did so because «his sons were not acting properly, he is remembered positively.»

moves.summary: if the sons misbehaved, he is praised
moves.about: whether one who disinherits misbehaving sons is praised or disapproved
